name: Athittayawong
contribution: The shortest-reigning monarch of Ayutthaya, ruling for about 36 days in 1629 and often regarded as the last king of the Sukhothai dynasty.

checks.lead: Athittayawong (Thai: อาทิตยวงศ์, Ādityavaṅśa) was the shortest-reigning monarch of Ayutthaya, ruling for about 36 days in 1629 and often regarded as the last king of the Sukhothai dynasty.
